data.narrative:
Sagence is a Series B frontier semiconductor company that has raised $58M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 8 private peers in Chips & Semiconductors at the same or adjacent funding stage—including SambaNova Systems ($11.0B, Series A), Rebellions ($2.3B, Series A), d-Matrix ($2.0B, Series A), Positron AI ($1.0B, Series B), and DEEPX ($529M, Series C)—alongside 3 public semiconductor benchmarks (ALAB, NVDA, AMD).

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis uses the $58M total raised as a proxy base and applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical for Series B progression, yielding $110M. Peer-median anchoring across the 5-company comparable set produces $2.0B, the midpoint of a $529M to $11.0B range. Public-comp P/S anchoring cannot be applied; the public Semiconductors sector trades at 18.4x median price-to-sales across the three tickers, but Sagence's revenue is not disclosed.

The two applicable methods support a valuation range of $94M (low bound, conservative application of stage progression) to $2.3B (high bound, upper-quartile peer comparable). The median across methods is approximately $1.1B. Key uncertainties include Sagence's revenue trajectory relative to peers and the appropriate stage discount relative to the higher-valuation Series A comparables in the sample.
